description.value: Pho Galaxy is a family-run Vietnamese restaurant inside Chilliwack's Southgate Shopping Centre, founded by Al Trieu and family on a commitment to scratch-made pho broth — beef bones, charred ginger, and star anise simmered all day with no concentrates or shortcuts. The restaurant grew from a small spot near Chilliwack General Hospital into a larger, community-loved destination that describes itself as 'worth the drive.' Touring cyclists will find a warm sit-down meal or quick takeout order made fresh to order.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and actively describes Pho Galaxy as a dine-in and takeout Vietnamese restaurant operating at Southgate Shopping Centre in Chilliwack, confirming the business is open. The OSM phone number (+1 6043921112) matches the website's (604) 392-1112, but the website address ('60-45905 Yale Road') adds a unit number absent from OSM. Takeout is confirmed by both OSM (takeaway=yes) and website ('Dine-in & Take-out'); washrooms are supported by OSM toilets=yes for a full dine-in establishment; no bike parking, Wi-Fi, or water refill details appear anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '45905 Yale Road' but the website specifies unit '60-45905 Yale Road, Southgate Shopping Centre' — the OSM record is missing the unit number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant with an active website and confirmed contact details; a solid hot-meal stop for touring cyclists in Chilliwack.
